messages:
Lina: Heads-up: staging canary failing on auth refresh tests (401) since 16:45 UTC. Blocking promote.

Tom: paste failure?

Lina: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::test_refresh_cycle
E AssertionError: expected 200 but got 401
E Resp headers: {"x-cache-status":"HIT", "x-cache-ttl":"-1"}
```

Adeel: -1 TTL = stale fixture from CI cache. We changed token payload earlier; CI returned old fixture.

Lina: Reran with fixtures disabled (`CI_FIXTURE_CACHE=0`) -> all green. With cache on fail 4/4.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused due to failing check `staging-e2e` (job 6809991301).

Tom: Fastest for release: pin to last-good image sha256:dd1122ee + manual promote, then evict fixtures and re-run. Approve?

Adeel: Approve. I'll run `ci/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging` after pin. Also create follow-up RD ticket to fix TTL handling.

Tom: Doing manual promote now: `deploybot promote --image=sha256:dd1122ee --env=staging --manual`.

ci-bot: Manual promote initiated by Tom; canary redeployed to sha256:dd1122ee (job 6809991301).

Adeel: Eviction complete; canary re-run passed. Staging e2e green.

Lina: Created RD-9009 "ci fixture cache TTL regression" assigned to Platform, P1 post-release; attached logs.

Tom: Added release-note: "auth-service pinned to last-good image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; will unpin after maintenance (RD-9009)."

deploy-bot: Promotion completed. Release window unblocked. :tada:
